newsitem.title: USA: U.S. mortgage application volume fell in latest wk.
newsitem.headline: U.S. mortgage application volume fell in latest wk.

text.p: The volume of U.S. mortgage applications fell 15.6 percent in the week ended July 4, according to a Mortgage Bankers Association of America weekly survey.
Specifically, the volume of applications to refinance mortgages fell 21.5 percent in the latest survey week, while applications to purchase mortgages declined 13.8 percent.
The seasonally adjusted refinancing index dipped 1.8 percent to 414.6 from 422.4 the previous week.
The purchase index advanced 7.4 percent to 223.4 in the latest survey from 208.0 in the previous week
